About Decentraland

Decentraland is a virtual world owned by its users, where land and items are NFTs. MANA is used to buy land, wearables and other items and for governance.

Where this MANA price comes from

The price above updates live in your browser from Coinbase (MANA-USD), Binance (MANA/USDT) and Kraken (MANA/USD), and the badge shows which exchange reported the latest trade.
